lede: Washington State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.6 against -1.1, a 2.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Washington State +5.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Arizona winning 63% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is qb room, where Arizona leads Washington State by 102 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
